evidence_items.explanation: The report presents severe safety-operation erosion as the current situation, citing a former employee and the absence of a safety team from the published chart. Its sources had already departed, however, and it does not date the safety dismissals to the February reorganization.

Musk's announcement establishes the reorganization's stated speed objective and acknowledges that some people were let go. It does not identify their functions or say that the safety operation was dismantled.

Musk frames safety as a shared responsibility rather than a separate department. This response falls outside the target period and supplies no staffing history, but it qualifies an inference that losing a dedicated team necessarily ended all safety work.

unresolved_gaps: No dated before-and-after safety roster or equivalent organizational record was located.
The original reporting does not establish when the safety team was let go relative to the February reorganization.
The extent of safety work retained within other teams is not established.
Later repetitions of The Verge report do not independently resolve these gaps.
